content_zh:
这些按钮如同黑洞一般，不时散发出一道道黑色的雾气。
一行蓝光小字出现在这排按钮上方：
“成功开启战神操作界面，现在可以免费激活第一项功能。”
“请问是否激活？”
“是。”
伴随着顾青山的确定，那一排黑洞似的按钮之中，第一个按钮缓缓显露出了名称。
“战神技艺？”
顾青山看着那个按钮的名称，迅速把相关说明读了一遍。
片刻后。
顾青山走到角落的武器架旁，审视着上面的几把兵器。
一把锈迹斑斑的长矛，一把损坏的弯刀，一张布满灰尘的军弓。
可惜没有剑。
整个游戏里选择剑修职业的玩家，有数千万之多，而顾青山是剑修排行榜上前十位的大剑仙。
这已经是顶尖高手的行列。
顾青山更是国家公会的战争指挥官，平日里方方面面都要管，战役打响之后更是没有一刻清闲。
就算是在现实世界中，他也要经常国外公会联合谋划战术，事务繁重驳杂。
曾经有不少顶尖高手替顾青山惋惜，说他的精力被过多牵绊，不然的话，他的剑术绝不会止步于前十，问鼎剑道第一人都有可能。
既然武器架上没有剑，顾青山只能遗憾的摇摇头，顺手拿起弯刀。
战神界面中立刻多出一段信息。
“军用制式弯刀（损坏），曾施展技能如下：”

“其一、横扫千军，施展者：王进。”
“其二、开门见山，施展者：张阔。”
“领悟两式刀术，各需消耗魂力1点。”
这段信息太惊人，以至于连顾青山也愣了愣。
能直接领悟招式，这就是战神技艺？
这还是战神操作界面的第一项功用，其他功能目前都是黑色，暂时无法使用。
不过这也够了啊，如果真是什么功法都能提取，那这个世界上还有什么功法秘诀，是自己不能得到的？
顾青山深吸一口气，等到心情略略平复，这才尝试着问道：“魂力是什么？”
立刻有一段小字显示在操作界面上。
“击杀生灵可获取魂力，已击杀剥皮血魔一头，获取魂力4点，目前魂力：45。”
杀掉一头剥皮血魔，一口气得到了4点魂力。
剥皮血魔已不算是普通妖魔了，其实力远超一般魔头和修士，更是善于隐匿和暗杀的好手。
幸好顾青山抓住机会反算对方，一举杀掉了此魔。
否则的话，以顾青山修为尽失的状况，双方一旦僵持下去，死的就不是剥皮血魔了。
顾青山点点头，原来是这样，但魂力显示的是45，这么说来，自己魂力的上限一共只有5点？
这也太少了。
刚这样想着，界面上又出现了一行小字。
“修为越高，魂力上限就越高。”
魂力跟修为有关联？
顾青山忍不住看了看自己的人物等级，只见上面醒目的标记着四个大字：“炼气一层”。

这是所有人进入异界的初始修炼等级，他上一世的等级已被抹去。
顾青山就叹了口气，默默放下弯刀，将锈迹斑斑的长矛抽了出来。
长矛上只有一招基础刺击。
摇摇头，丢下长矛，顾青山又拿起那一张军弓。
“军用制式军弓，曾施展如下技能：”
“其一、稳定，施展者：张羽。”
“其二、连射，施展者：张羽。”
“其三、精确，施展者：张羽。”
“其四、燕双飞，施展者：张羽。”
“领悟稳定、连射，各需消耗魂力2点，
领悟精确，需消耗魂力4点，
领悟燕双飞，需消耗魂力6点。”
根据记忆中的信息，张羽正是守护这座军营的人族将军，擅长刀弓，于上一次攻防战中，死在了饮血魔的手中。
顾青山目光扫过四个技能，重点看了看“燕双飞”。
这个招式居然需要消耗6点魂力，一下子就超出了顾青山的魂力上限。
“唉，才炼气一层，看来必须从头修行，尽快提高魂力上限。”
顾青山无奈摇头。
所谓炼气境，便是最低等级的修行者。
炼气之上，还有筑基，更有金丹、元婴、化神等境界，不过这都是后话了。
好消息还是有的，那就是玩家的修为，可以带回现实世界。

炼气一层，已经可以感应和使用灵力了。
如果真的能以这种状态回归到过去，就算所有的装备都找不回来，就算所有的技能都遗失掉，顾青山也一万个愿意。

content_en:
These buttons are like black holes, emitting black mist from time to time.
A line of small blue letters appeared above the row of buttons:
"The God of War operation interface has been successfully opened, and the first function can now be activated for free."
"Would you like to activate it?"
"Yes."
With Gu Qingshan's confirmation, the name of the first button in the row of black hole-like buttons slowly revealed.
"God of War Skills?"
Gu Qingshan looked at the name of the button and quickly read the relevant instructions.
After a while.
Gu Qingshan walked to the weapons rack in the corner and examined the weapons on it.
A rusty spear, a damaged scimitar, and a dusty military bow.
It's a pity that there is no sword.
There are tens of millions of players who choose the sword cultivator profession in the entire game, and Gu Qingshan is one of the top ten great swordsmen on the sword cultivator rankings.
This is already among the top experts.
Gu Qingshan is the war commander of the National Guild. He has to take care of all aspects on weekdays. After the battle started, he never had a moment of leisure.
Even in the real world, he often has to jointly plan tactics with foreign guilds, and the affairs are complicated and complicated.
Many top masters once felt sorry for Gu Qingshan, saying that his energy was tied up too much. Otherwise, his swordsmanship would never stop at the top ten, and he might even become the number one swordsman.
Since there was no sword on the weapons rack, Gu Qingshan could only shake his head regretfully and picked up the scimitar.
An additional piece of information immediately appeared in the God of War interface.
"Military standard scimitar (damaged), the skills used are as follows:"
"First, sweep across thousands of armies, performed by: Wang Jin."
"Second, get straight to the point, and the one who performs it is Zhang Kuo."
"To understand the two styles of swordsmanship, each requires 1 point of soul power."
This piece of information was so shocking that even Gu Qingshan was stunned.
Being able to directly understand moves, is this the skill of the God of War?
This is the first function of the Ares operating interface. Other functions are currently black and temporarily unavailable.
But this is enough. If it is true that all techniques can be extracted, then what other techniques and secrets are there in this world that I cannot obtain?
Gu Qingshan took a deep breath, waited until his mood calmed down slightly, and then tried to ask: "What is soul power?"
Immediately, a small text was displayed on the operation interface.
"You can gain soul power by killing creatures. You have killed a Skinned Blood Demon and gained 4 soul power points. Current soul power is: 45."
Killed a skinned blood demon and got 4 points of soul power in one breath.
The Skinned Blood Demon is no longer an ordinary demon. Its strength far exceeds that of ordinary demons and monks, and it is also good at concealment and assassination.
Fortunately, Gu Qingshan seized the opportunity to counterattack the opponent and killed the demon in one fell swoop.
Otherwise, with Gu Qingshan's complete loss of cultivation, once the stalemate between the two sides continues, it won't be the Skinned Blood Demon who dies.
Gu Qingshan nodded, so that was the case, but the soul power displayed was 45. So, the upper limit of his soul power was only 5 points in total?
This is too little.
Just as I was thinking this, another line of small words appeared on the interface.
"The higher the cultivation level, the higher the upper limit of soul power."
Is soul power related to cultivation?
Gu Qingshan couldn't help but look at his character level, and saw four big words clearly marked on it: "Level 1 of Qi Refining".
This is the initial level of cultivation for everyone entering another world. His level in the previous life has been erased.
Gu Qingshan sighed, silently put down his machete, and pulled out the rusty spear.
There is only one basic thrust on the spear.
Shaking his head, dropping the spear, Gu Qingshan picked up the military bow again.
"Military standard military bow, has used the following skills:"
"First, stability, performer: Zhang Yu."
"Second, continuous shooting, performer: Zhang Yu."
"Third, precision, performer: Zhang Yu."
"Fourth, Yan Shuangfei, performer: Zhang Yu."
"To understand stability and continuous shooting, each requires 2 points of soul power.
collarTo realize the accuracy, you need to consume 4 points of soul power.
To understand Yan Shuangfei, you need to consume 6 points of soul power. "
According to the information in his memory, Zhang Yu was the human general who guarded this military camp. He was good at swords and bows. He died at the hands of the blood-drinking demon in the last offensive and defensive battle.
Gu Qingshan glanced at the four skills, focusing on "Yan Shuangfei".
This move actually required 6 points of soul power, which suddenly exceeded Gu Qingshan's upper limit of soul power.
"Alas, I'm only at the first level of Qi refining. It seems I have to practice from scratch to increase the upper limit of my soul power as soon as possible. "
Gu Qingshan shook his head helplessly.
The so-called Qi Refining Realm is the lowest level of practitioners.
On top of Qi refining, there is also foundation building, and there are also realms such as golden elixir, Yuanying, and god transformation, but these are all things for another day.
There is still good news, that is, players’ cultivation can be brought back to the real world.
At the first level of Qi refining, you can already sense and use spiritual power.
If he could really return to the past in this state, even if all the equipment could not be found, even if all the skills were lost, Gu Qingshan would still be willing to do so.
